top_signals.title: Des Bishop on China's Comedy Boom and Censorship
top_signals.summary:
Stand-up comedy is booming across China, trailing only cinema as the country's second-largest theater category, according to state media. Many credit American comic Des Bishop with sparking the trend over a decade ago after he moved to Beijing, learned Mandarin from scratch, and built a stand-up routine that helped lay the groundwork for today’s scene.
Bloomberg’s Stephen Engle met with Bishop in Hong Kong to discuss the industry's evolution. (Source: Bloomberg)

top_signals.title: Kiwi Slide Haunts New Zealand Parties Ahead of Tight Vote
top_signals.summary: New Zealand’s weakening currency is compounding the cost-of-living pressures turning voters away from the country’s main political parties ahead of next week’s election.
